_comment: Central settings. Values marked null MUST be filled from constant/sprayCloudProperties of the copied tutorial (the analysis refuses to run otherwise, so a wrong correlation comparison cannot happen by accident).
_mode_comment: cold = same chamber at cold_temperature_K, evaporation negligible, tip penetration is comparable with the Hiroyasu-Arai correlation. evaporating = tutorial as shipped (liquid length saturates, correlation no longer applies after break-up/evaporation).
_mesh_comment: Factors scale the number of cells per direction of the tutorial blockMeshDict. Factor 1.0 = tutorial mesh. Cells grow with factor^3.

injector._comment: origin/direction as in the tutorial (check position/direction in sprayCloudProperties). Effective injection velocity: Umag in the injection model. Pressure drop for the correlation is derived as dp = 0.5*rho_l*U^2 (discharge/velocity coefficient = 1); state this assumption in the README.
injector._basis: sprayCloudProperties (ESI v2606 aachenBomb): outerDiameter 1.9e-4; flowType flowRateAndDischarge, Cd 0.9, massTotal 6e-6 kg over 1.25 ms with a time-varying flowRateProfile, so U(t)=mdot(t)/(Cd*A*rho). Peak ~389 m/s, mean over 0-1 ms ~305 m/s (used here). rho = n-heptane liquid at T0=320 K, ~662 kg/m3 (literature estimate, NOT read from OpenFOAM; tutorial rho0=1000 is a placeholder). The correlation assumes constant U, so this is an approximation.
